academic.passage: The theory of evolution is a fundamental concept in biology that explains how species change over time through a process known as natural selection. This process suggests that individuals with traits that enhance their chances of survival and reproduction are more likely to pass on these traits to future generations. Over long periods, this leads to the gradual development of new species and the adaptation of existing ones to their environments.

questions.q: What is the main idea of the passage?
options: The theory of evolution explains species change.
Natural selection is not important in evolution.
All species evolve at the same rate.
